content:
oncall-bot: Incident detected — high OOM rate on serving cluster 'svc-gamma' (us-west-2). Spike started ~2026-03-17T05:12Z. Creating thread 1729101112
alyssa: I'm taking this. pulling logs + node health.
matt: Seeing repeated container restarts with CUDA errors on the paged-attn runtime path. Might be allocator fragmentation + KV cache leak slow creep.
emily: Any customer impact? numbers on 5xx/latency?
jordan: Support: two active tickets reporting failures and high latency (C-3412, C-3413). Both on prod workloads.
alyssa: Quick check: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving | grep OOMKilled` shows 6 pods in CrashLoopBackOff / OOMKilled. Node correlation: gpu-12*, gpu-13*.
matt: Paste from runtime logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T05:14:03Z] cuda: cuCtxPushCurrent failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress
[2026-03-17T05:14:03Z] process(pid=23445) killed by OOM, RSS growth pattern: +1.2GB/min
[2026-03-17T05:14:04Z] allocator: paged-attn slab fragmented, free-slices delta -27%
```
emily: That matches the slow-creep pattern we've seen where KV pages aren't being released (refcount leak) and paged-attn slabs get micro-fragmented until OOM.
matt: Repro on staging: KV eviction logic didn't fire for small-prefix hits; small allocations pile up and fragmentation prevents reuse. Short-term knob: lower `kvcache.max_retention_seconds` and make eviction more aggressive.
alyssa: Can we push an override to affected svc instances?
deploy-bot: Rolling config override -> namespace redwood-serving, svc svc-gamma: setting `kvcache.max_retention_seconds=60` (was 3600). 6 pods targeted.
matt: Also enabling allocator compaction GC by setting `ALLOC_COMPACT_INTERVAL=30s`. Runtime accepts SIGHUP to apply without full restart.
alyssa: Applying SIGHUP on targeted pods now.
emily: While config lands, recommend cordon + drain for the hottest node to avoid noisy restarts and customer errors.
alyssa: Executing:
```
kubectl cordon node-gpu-12.usw2
kubectl drain node-gpu-12.usw2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
```
jordan: Noting Dedicated customer affected — escalating to account team and drafting customer message. SLA risk if errors persist.
matt: Long-term fix: allocator patch to coalesce tiny free ranges on the paged-attn path and fix KV cache refcount edge-case when prefix rehash race occurs. Will open PR with regression test simulating slow-leak.
emily: Observability: enabling verbose kvmetrics on affected pods for 24h (`/api/admin/metrics?kv=1`) and increasing export frequency to 15s.
alyssa: Current dashboard: error-rate down ~70% since configs rolled and compaction enabled. Pod restarts tapered from ~5/min to ~0-1/min. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
ops-monitor: Suppressing alert for 20m while mitigations settle; will re-open if OOM > 2/min across cluster.
jordan: Support note — posting interim update to C-3412/3413: mitigation applied, investigations continuing, ETA for root cause fix ~48-72h.
alyssa: Handing off to night oncall @mike — status: mitigated (reduced errors) but root cause pending. Follow PR #789 for allocator/KV fix and telemetry work.
mike: Acknowledged, will watch metrics and follow up with postmortem draft if we see recurrence.
